nodes.description: Public pure function G_Face(uint32 traitId_) that returns a two-element string array containing the face name and a base64-encoded SVG image; the body is a chain of equality checks on traitId_ with a fallback empty pair.
Calldata parameter traitId_ of type uint32 that selects which of the sixteen hardcoded face assets is returned.
Local memory string _header holding the constant base64 prefix that is concatenated with a per-trait suffix via abi.encodePacked before being returned.

edges.reason: The parameter traitId_ is read by G_Face in a sequence of if (traitId_ == N) comparisons and therefore flows into the function body, determining the returned asset.
The local _header string is used inside G_Face in abi.encodePacked(_header, <suffix>) for every return branch, so its value flows into the function's output.
G_Face declares and branches on its parameter traitId_, giving the function control over the parameter's evaluation path.

normalization_plan.reason: traitId_ is a non-core parameter whose only use is inside G_Face; it should be folded into the function node to reduce graph noise.
_header is a non-core local variable initialized and consumed entirely within G_Face, so it should be merged into the function node.
